correctness.rationale: For 0<=k<2^r-1, expand binomial(2^r-1,k) as (-1)^k product(1-2^r/j) in the 2-adic integers. Mod 2^s terms with valuation v2(j)<=r-s vanish, leaving j=m*2^(r-s+1). Thus the prefix product formula is exact. The inverse of n=2^r-1 is -1 mod 2^s and cancels adjacent alternating signs. Uniform block partition and seven explicitly computed mod16 transitions rigorously prove all stated counts. Independent exact-integer checks passed 56,780 row positions.
